source: vendor/hermes-agent (v0.23.2) gateway/hosted_room_discussion.py: _MENTION_RE and resolve_mentions (the handle rule), validate_roster (the reserved handles), _format_message and _build_prompt (the human is "User (user)" and "the user" in every member's prompt)
rules: A mention is every non-overlapping match of pattern, scanned left to right; the handle is the whole run after the @, compared case-folded. "@kai." names the handle "kai.", which is nobody.
A handle in everyone names every member of the room and never the human (the engine's resolve_mentions returns the roster).

The engine reserves no handle for the human: it names the human "user" ("User (user): ..." in the transcript each member reads). A message addresses the human when it mentions the handle in user and no member of the room has that handle; a member whose handle is user takes the mention, as the engine routes it.
Any other handle names the member whose handle it is, or nobody.
